claims.feature: Escapes the special characters and round-trips back to the same text
Decodes every named, decimal and hex entity
tests: ui:html-escape-unescape:entity reference table: every named, decimal and hex form in it decodes to its character

claims.feature: Escape profiles, including non-ASCII as numeric references
tests: ui:html-escape-unescape:escape profiles: essential leaves '/', non-ASCII becomes hex refs

gaps: FreeFormatter puts escaping for HTML, XML, JavaScript, JSON, CSV and SQL on one site; on Layerbit, XML, JSON and URL escaping live in their own tools.
